content.value: Suppose you have a broadcast channel in Ethernet CSMA/CD algorithm with transmission rate 10 Mbps where a node can transmit a frame of max 1500 bytes, and maximum propagation delay between 2 nodes is: 2ms.
i) Calculate the efficiency of the algorithm.
ii) When would it reach its highest efficiency, and why?
